measurement: tragus length (Trag), four individuals, Guangxi specimens
method: external measurement with electronic digital calipers (Methods: 'Morphological measurements of bats were performed with electronic digital calipers according to' Dai et al. 2020); Methods list 'Trag, tragus length'; four individual values as printed in Table 1, no species mean printed
conditions: Four bats from Maoershan National Nature Reserve, Guangxi, China (two sites, 2002 m and 1708 m a.s.l.), harp-trapped in June 2022. Table 1 prints one value per specimen under 'GD-221656(♂) / GD-221657(♂) / GD-221658(♂) / GD-221659(♀)', so the filed value is four individual values in that order: GD-221656 male, GD-221657 male, GD-221658 male, GD-221659 female (not a mean; no mean is printed). Age is not stated. The paper says the specimens 'were preserved in anhydrous ethanol after all examinations were completed', so the measurements were taken before preservation; it does not say whether the bats were alive or dead when measured. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.

method: Methods: external measurements (HB, TL, HF, EL) 'taken in the field with a ruler to the nearest 0.1 mm'; Table 2 gives mean ± SD, range and n for the new species
conditions: Type series of the new species (Dabie Mountains, Anhui, China; eleven specimens collected May 2017 to August 2020); Table 2 gives N = 11 for the species but the EL cell gives n = 9, and the paper does not say which nine.
